How Does Central Identity Federation Unify Multi-Tenant SSO, Custom Domains & Dual-RP Passkeys?

Long image

A

Answer

SCRIPE decouples interactive identity UI (https://auth.scripe.org) from callback ingress (https://api.scripe.org). Custom domains, post-MFA handoffs, Dual-RP passkeys, Sudo step-up, and split logouts remain strictly fail-closed.

  1. Central Callback & Post-MFA Bridge: OIDC and SAML callbacks on api.scripe.org consume server ExternalAuthStateTicket and mint a 120s SHA-256 ExternalAuthHandoffTicket. PostMfaHandoffHelper and ssoTwoFactorBridge.ts bridge hybrid-2FA back to {ReturnOrigin}/sso/callback.
  2. Custom-Domain First-Party HMAC Relay: Next.js BFF exposes /api/auth/session/{establish,refresh,logout} with HMAC-SHA256 headers (30s skew, 60s nonce, Client-Ip rate limit, MaxAge: 0 parity) and issues __Host-scripe_refresh_token (SameSite=Lax).
  3. Dual-RP Passkeys, UserVerification=required & 3-DB Parity: AdminPasskey.RpId keeps EnableCentralNativeAndPasskeyMigration locked false with WebAuthn:UserVerification = "required", PasskeyAuthLimit = 12 (15m), and --idempotent parity on PostgreSQL 18, SQL Server 2025, and Oracle 21c XE.
  4. Cloudflare Edge, Provider Runbook, Sudo & Split Logout: Edge enforces Cloudflare X-Scripe-Origin-Verify -> Railway ForwardedHeaders__ForwardLimit=2, Entra email+xms_edov, GitHub user:email read:user, 2-step SAML ACS, 403 <SudoVerificationModal /> retry, sibling-JTI RevokeAllSessions, and split logoutScope.

Applies toSCRIPE-Backend (e64e61e65) + SCRIPE-Frontend (eea985c95) + SCRIPE-CLI (0cc99a3)

How Do Central Auth, API Callbacks, Post-MFA Bridging & Custom-Domain Relay Connect?

Diagram structure
  • auth.scripe.org fe_auth
  • Custom Tenant BFF fe_custom
  • admin.scripe.org fe_native
  • api.scripe.org api_cb
  • Relay, Sudo & Dual-RP sec_gate
  • PG / SQL / Oracle 21c id_store
  • fe_auth → api_cb · OIDC/SAML + 2FA
  • fe_custom → sec_gate · HMAC BFF
  • sec_gate → api_cb · /sso/handoff
  • fe_native → sec_gate · WebAuthn + Sudo
  • api_cb → id_store
  • sec_gate → id_store

Click any highlighted node below to trace host boundaries, post-MFA handoff bridging, HMAC relay signing, Dual-RP WebAuthn (UserVerification=required), and multi-DB persistence.

  1. auth.scripe.org UI & Post-MFA Bridge ↗

    Interactive SSO start, /sso/continue workspace picker, and hybrid-2FA challenge (ssoTwoFactorBridge.ts -> PostMfaHandoffHelper + TenantOriginOwnershipValidator).

  2. Custom-Domain BFF Relay ↗

    Next.js /api/auth/session/{establish,refresh,logout} enforces same-origin headers, signs X-Scripe-Session-Relay-* (with Client-Ip & MaxAge: 0 parity), and sets __Host-scripe_refresh_token (Lax).

  3. Native & Passkey Origin ↗

    Locked on admin.scripe.org and *.admin.scripe.org (EnableCentralNativeAndPasskeyMigration: false, WebAuthn:UserVerification = "required", PasskeyAuthLimit = 12).

  4. Central Callback & Cloudflare Edge ↗

    OidcClientController.Central and SAML ACS behind Cloudflare X-Scripe-Origin-Verify + Railway ForwardedHeaders__ForwardLimit=2 redeem server state and mint 120s SHA-256 ExternalAuthHandoffTicket.

  5. Relay, Dual-RP & Sudo Gate ↗

    SessionRelayAuthenticator (30s skew, 60s nonce), IVerifiedOriginEvaluator, Fido2PasskeyService, RevokeAllSessions sibling-JTI blacklist, and AuthLogoutScopeHelper (POST ~/oidc/logout).

  6. Redis + 3-DB Persistence ↗

    Stores auth:ext-handoff-used:{sha256}, relay nonces, and AdminPasskey.RpId (varchar(253)) verified --idempotent across PostgreSQL 18, SQL Server 2025, and live Oracle 21c XE.

How Do Central Callback, Post-MFA Bridging & Custom-Domain Relay Execute Step by Step?

When a custom-domain user authenticates via an external IdP and tenant policy requires SCRIPE 2FA, auth.scripe.org/sso/continue completes the 2FA challenge and mints a fresh single-use post-MFA ExternalAuthHandoffTicket back to {ReturnOrigin}/sso/callback.

Diagram structure
  • Custom Domain SPA spa
  • auth.scripe.org auth
  • Next.js HMAC Relay bff
  • api.scripe.org api
  • External IdP idp
  • spa → api · POST /api/v1/auth/oidc/challenge
  • api → spa · idpUrl (ExternalAuthStateTicket cached)
  • spa → idp · authenticate at IdP
  • idp → api · GET /api/v1/auth/oidc/callback
  • api → auth · 302 auth.scripe.org/sso/continue (Requires2FA)
  • auth → api · POST /2fa/verify (twoFactorPendingToken + returnOrigin)
  • api → auth · PostMfaHandoffHelper -> 120s post-MFA HandoffTicket
  • auth → spa · 302 {ReturnOrigin}/sso/callback?code=&state=
  • spa → bff · POST /api/auth/session/establish
  • bff → api · HMAC X-Scripe-Session-Relay-* + /sso/handoff
  • bff → spa · Access JWT JSON + __Host-scripe_refresh_token

Decision 2, WebAuthn UserVerification=required & Multi-DB Parity

CentralFederationOptions.EnableCentralNativeAndPasskeyMigration stays false in all environments while WebAuthn:UserVerification is "required" and RateLimiting:PasskeyAuthLimit is 12 (15m). AddPasskeyRpIdFilteredIndexAndEncryptedTotpStorage (9aedf12b9) is verified with 0 errors across --idempotent fresh and replay runs on PostgreSQL 18, SQL Server 2025 Express (deferred RpId backfill), and live Oracle 21c XE (XEPDB1 IDENTITY schema).
